test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The 2010 Commonwealth Games were a significant event in India. Which metropolitan city hosted the games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2010 Commonwealth Games** were hosted in **New Delhi, India**. This was the **19th edition** of the Commonwealth Games.
 
• It was the **first time** that the Commonwealth Games were held in India and the second time in Asia (the first being in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, in 1998).
 
• The games were held between **3rd October to 14th October 2010**, with participation from 71 nations and territories.
 
• The main venue for the games was the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, which hosted the opening and closing ceremonies.
 
• New Delhi successfully organized the games, with India ranking **second** in the overall medal tally, winning a total of **101 medals** (38 Gold, 27 Silver, and 36 Bronze).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games:**

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games are an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations, held every four years.
 
• The games were first held in **1930** in Hamilton, Canada, and were then called the **British Empire Games**.
 
• The games promote sports, culture, and unity among Commonwealth nations.
 
 
 
• **2010 Commonwealth Games Highlights:**
 
 
• The mascot of the 2010 Games was **Shera**, a Royal Bengal Tiger.
 
• The official song was "**Jiyo Utho Bado Jeeto**" composed by A.R. Rahman.
 
• The games included **17 sports** and **272 events**.
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium:**
 
 
• The Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, located in New Delhi, is one of the largest stadiums in India with a seating capacity of around **60,000**.
 
• It underwent significant renovation for the 2010 Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance:**
 
 
• India achieved its best-ever performance in the 2010 Commonwealth Games, securing the **second rank** in the medal tally.
 
• Significant contributors to India's medals included disciplines like shooting, wrestling, boxing, and badminton.
 
 
 
• **Recent Commonwealth Games**:
 
 
• The **22nd Commonwealth Games** were held in **Birmingham, UK**, in **2022**.
 
• The upcoming **23rd Commonwealth Games** will take place in **Glasgow, Scotland**, from **July 23 to August 2, 2026**.
 
• **India** has also been confirmed to host the **2030** Centenary Games in **Ahmedabad**.
